snippet.title: Tattoo Tycoon // Release Date Anouncement Teaser
snippet.description:
#TattooTycoon #Ink #Simulation 

In Tattoo Tycoon, you take over the last standing tattoo parlor in a city where most shops have closed their doors. It’s up to you to turn this struggling business into a thriving artistic empire. Success hinges on a steady hand and a keen understanding of your clients, from eccentric regulars to the city’s most powerful figure, known only as "the Tycoon."

Players can begin their journey to restore Tattuga Bay's faded ink scene on October 24th on Steam, Epic, GOG, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch.

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375260/Tattoo_Tycoon/
